setup: You are finding the slope of the line through two given points.

steps.say: Slope is rise over run: the change in y is \([[rise]]\) and the change in x is \([[run]]\). Subtract the coordinates in the same order both times, or the sign will flip.
Dividing gives the slope \([[slope]]\), which is the same between any two points on the line -- that sameness is what makes a line straight.
